<thought>The most intense peak at m/z 121.0528 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral mass of ~120.0455 Da. The formula C₄H₈O₄ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 120.0423 Da, matching the observed mass within a few ppm, making it the best candidate.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
